snippet.title: "Dungeon Antiqua"is officially coming to consoles!
snippet.description:
"Dungeon Antiqua, the retro-inspired dungeon-crawler RPG, is coming to consoles!
Available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S simultaneously on ✨July 30th! ✨

◆Nintendo Store
https://nintendo.com/us/store/products/dungeon-antiqua-switch

◆PlayStation Store
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019343

◆Microsoft Store

◆Official Site
